Most Recent Quarterly Refunding Documents Treasury releases a variety of documents and data relating to Treasury borrowing and debt management policy each quarter. Find them here. Quarterly Refunding Webcasts Each quarter, Treasury provides a live web stream of its presentation of the quarterly refunding statement and questions and answers with the press. Find links to past Quarterly Refunding Webcasts here. Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee (TBAC) Each quarter, Treasury debt managers consult with the (TBAC). Information about TBAC members and their backgrounds can be found here. Primary Dealers Each quarter, Treasury debt managers meet with primary dealers that trade with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York in the U.S. government securities market. Find out more about them here. Quarterly Refunding Archives Looking for data and documents released as part of past Treasury Quarterly Refundings?
